title: Waldorf Salad
intro: First presented at the Waldorf Astoria Hotel in 1893, with additions in 2019…
ingredients: Pinch of freshly ground black pepper
1 cup red seedless grapes, sliced in half (or 1/4 cup of raisins)
steps: In a medium sized bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Stir in the apple, celery, grapes, chicken and walnuts. Serve on a bed of fresh lettuce.
